company.name: Grab
company.shortDescription: Grab is a mobile application that provides taxi, payment, lending, and insurance services.
company.description:
Grab operates a mobile technology platform that integrates city transportation for driver-partners and customers in South East Asia. It offers services like GrabTaxi, GrabCar, GrabHitch, GrabShare, GrabCoach, GrabShuttle, GrabShuttle Plus, GrabFamily, JustGrab, GrabNow, and GrabRental. 

Grab offers services in Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, and Myanmar. Anthony Tan and Tan Hooi Lng founded it in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore. It has additional offices in Seattle, Beijing, Bangalore, Jakarta, and Vietnam.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Debt round raised $1,500,000,000, or 8.32% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 31 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 97 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
